issues.description: The expected return type of messageOnMilk() is inconsistent between the problem statement and the solution. The UML snippet and Part 2 textual description in the problem statement indicate messageOnMilk() should return a boolean (true/false), while the class-level UML entries for Seal/Goat and the solution implementation define messageOnMilk() to return a String. This ambiguity prevents students from knowing whether to implement a boolean status or a descriptive String and will cause compilation/signature mismatches with the provided solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type for messageOnMilk() consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: update the problem statement (UML and textual description) to specify messageOnMilk(): String and describe the expected String format (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked") OR change the solution to use boolean and update class implementations and UML accordingly. Ensure the UML, textual instructions, template, and solution all match the chosen signature.

issues.description: The template Farm.java declares a private helper method singFarmSongVerse with a commented-out parameter (/*Animal animal*/) whereas the UML and the solution declare singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch may confuse students when they try to implement singFarmSong() to call singFarmSongVerse(animal) and could lead to compilation errors unless they modify the template signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Uncomment or add the Animal parameter in the template's singFarmSongVerse signature to match the UML and solution (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to reflect a parameterless helper if that was the intended design. Prefer aligning the template with the UML/solution to avoid unnecessary confusion.
